narrative.overview: Magi is a sheet of the operating system that happens to know where your files are. System type, native window materials, one cool accent, tonal layers and a 150 ms fade; the user's files are the most colorful thing on screen.
keyCharacteristics: File types as saturated glyph squares

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Azure Signal marks what the user is acting on or what the system is doing; it never decorates.

rules.name: The Tint Floor Rule
rules.body: Over a blurred backdrop, light mode never drops below 85% panel opacity and dark mode never below 75%.

rules.name: The Native Voice Rule
rules.body: Never bundle or specify a typeface; weight and size carry hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat; state is a background tint and press nudges down.

dos: Do let the OS draw its materials
Do keep every border a 1 px hairline
Do show why a result matched on every row
Do animate arrival with the 150 ms ease-out fade only
Do use file-type glyph colors only on the 32 px glyph squares
donts: Don't add a bundled typeface, gradient text, or decorative illustration
Don't use the accent as a fill for large surfaces or as a second status color
Don't add drop shadows in dark mode
Don't use bright status colors for the word beside a dot unless it is a problem
Don't let the logo mark appear in more than one color
